name: 数量を動かして割合を考える
prompt:
Edit reference 1 (the registered current candidate) as a 390 × 760 px portrait component. Make one focused correction while preserving its successful pure-white/no-tint treatment, Japanese copy, ratio exercise and success state.

The character was incorrectly redrawn in reference 1. Replace that generated drawing with the exact original Bea image from reference 2 as unchanged placed media. Use the supplied pixels directly: do not illustrate, regenerate, trace, crop, recolor, shade, texture or reinterpret Bea. Place the exact artwork at x=24/y=70, 109×161 px, matching the native preview. The hair, face, yellow band and shirt, brown skin, cyan pants, pose and edges must match reference 2 exactly.

Align the upper content to the native preview (reference 3): heading x=16/y=8, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, exact text “ビーを手伝いましょう”. White question card x=144/y=90, 230×118, thin neutral #E4E4E4 outline; exact copy at x=160/y=116, 198×48, Meiryo Regular 14/24:
米3に対して水1になる
組合せを作りましょう。
Keep divider x=16/y=246, 358×1; ratio board x=16/y=278, 358×252; bottom draggable items at y=578 and y=584; white success region begins at y=666; success text x=16/y=676; green CTA x=16/y=708, 358×44. Preserve these anchors and the three rice containers to one water cup composition.

Keep every broad surface and empty container interior pure white #FFFFFF: page, question card, board, rice bags, cup bodies and success region. No mint, blush, cream, gray or green tinted fills; no colored shadow, gradient, glow, texture or tinted border. Use forest green only for rice outlines, success text and the flat CTA; use neutral slate only for vessel outlines and thin separators; use one solid saturated blue only for the water itself. Preserve the correct Japanese copy and white button label “次へ進む”. Keep a compact, flat, high-contrast screen with no new decorations or app chrome.

References 4 and 5 provide original source context and the restrained green-on-white palette. Return the component only.
reviewNotes: Pure-white surfaces and no pale tint fills verified. The original Bea illustration remains visibly redrawn and vertical alignment still differs after one correction; correction limit reached.
